mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pmis_rate_card WHERE rate_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM pmis_rate_card WHERE level_code = #{levelCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND effective_date <= #{date} AND (expiry_date IS NULL OR expiry_date >= #{date}) AND deleted = 0 AND ( (COALESCE(project_type,'') = COALESCE(#{projectType},'') AND COALESCE(customer_level,'') = COALESCE(#{customerLevel},'')) OR (COALESCE(project_type,'') = COALESCE(#{projectType},'') AND customer_level IS NULL) OR (project_type IS NULL AND customer_level IS NULL) ) ORDER BY (CASE WHEN project_type IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), (CASE WHEN customer_level IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM pmis_rate_card WHERE level_code = #{levelCode} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY effective_date DESC
SELECT * FROM pmis_rate_card WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY level_code ASC
